paragraphs: Jadu sells a digital platform built for local government, higher education and healthcare. Its core products cover accessible websites, online forms and real-time case management tools.

Jadu Central is presented as extensible, accessible and secure, and as all an organisation needs to manage websites and online forms. Online forms capture customer data ready for transfer to other systems for further storage and processing. A MyAccount option lets end users access key services, raise and track cases, make payments and see account information. An integrations hub links Jadu products to third party services such as Office 365 Calendars.

Jadu was founded in 2001 by Suraj Kika, Chief Growth Officer, and Andy Perkins, Chief Solutions Architect. The company states that hundreds of public and private institutions around the world have chosen the platform. Its home page presents the business as Jadu, A Netcall Company. Case studies on the site include one for Medway Council. Another covers Wright County.
